items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: when I got a date with him I found out that he was certainly a fine man to do business with

ctx.x: was guaranteed for a night, but some of them would even take that and Basie said before he knew me and everything, some of the guys would say, well, let's try Ernie, and somebody who had been in the band would say, well, that's one thing about him, he'll be fair with you and make you feel you.

Incidentally, I was told about Basie when I started booking and when I got a date with him I found out that he was certainly a fine man to do business with, because the kind of band that he had, he played for the people.

Well, I worked with Basie Gibbens' band when I first came back from Count Basie's band, 1948; I worked the whole summer with him, and I still enjoyed a great friendship with Basie Gibbens; Elmer is his real name.
